test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six girls, P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in two lines, one line behind the other line. All the girls are facing north. In the front line there are three girls. The remaining girls are sitting in the second line. T is just behind P. R is sitting to the immediate left of U. S is between T and Q. S is sitting to the immediate left of Q. Who is sitting just behind R?
solution:
Six girls, **P, Q, R, S, T and U** are sitting in two lines, one line behind the other line. 

All the girls are facing north. 

In the front line there are three girls. 

The remaining girls are sitting in the second line. 

1. S is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

2. S is between T and Q.

3. T is just behind P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb0b4ffb05262c2b3689a61ce2abf7f5cc66fc6a0ebf051d4e1133ef27abb56b.png] 

4. R is sitting to the immediate left of U. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd3a6d71ff45dc3668914049aed57712680b478a430bdd2cbc46a5b53cd181e1.png] 

Clearly, S is sitting just behind R.

Hence, '**S**' is the correct answer.
